summary: Tier now re-decided after the rows decision (expand/collapse) in the same frame; two docs corrected; stills retaken.

findings.detail: labels.ts position(): the tier computation is now a local settle() run at the top of the loop (so hidden plates still rest) and again right after expand()/collapse(), so is-expanded and the raised tier change in the same frame. Spec not loosened.
docs/05-playback.md A-1 and docs/12-glossary.md Holo label now say every plate rests at T4 Sky and rises to its own tier when raised (13 R1, 15 s6).
stills.ts now clears the selection by clicking empty sky (not Esc, which goes back a level) and plays from 30% waiting for a raised plate. See limitations for the still's state.
